statement: Implement Q8 resumable bulk data load across the bulk-load manifest contract, bulk-load command owner, and CLI bulk-load router so multi-batch NDJSON/CSV loads validate schema/source/batch digests, persist durable checkpoints and reject rows in SQL only after Raft commit ack, replay idempotently on primary-key conflict across crash/restart, refuse schema drift/source truncation/offset regression/mutated batch replay, and verify external pgwire completeness via key-range SHA-256 digests and sample row reconciliation.
